peerPolicyTemplate.rules: Closed exact6keys, no schemaVersion. version1..2^53-1; expiry strictly future and <=7days on read; max2 unique lowercase64hex actual CP-client DER fingerprints. Empty list denies all. Freeze exact UTF8 bytes/hash before start. Journal refuses lower version/sameversion different bytes; reread on authorization.
